results.title: Estranged
results.overview: A young couple have a peaceful evening at a park when they meet a strange young girl carrying a black balloon. Later that night, strange things begin to happen, turning their ordinary evening into a disturbing experience where nothing is quite what it seems.

results.title: Lotus
results.overview: Sultan, an illiterate elderly woman, searches for her hospitalized husband's room. Wandering through the hospital's labyrinthine corridors, she crosses paths with completely different lives and confronts the harsh realities of life.

results.title: Opetael
results.overview: When 19-year-old artist Megi is rejected from her dream art school, her childhood imaginary friend, Opetael, mysteriously reappears. Together, they must figure out who is the serial killer who murdered the course's top three accepted applicants - before the killer strikes again...

results.title: The Rocky Road To NYC
results.overview: When a young man (Cian Ryan Murphy) is awoken to his reality and snatched from his dream life in New York City, he loses his job and thus begins his quest to turn that hallucination into a tangible truth.

results.title: He's Not Alone
results.overview: An idealistic man struggles to cope with the fact that his nightmare from the night prior might have actually been real.

results.title: Heartsong: Scene by scene
results.overview: The visual album accompanying Gretta Ray's third studio album, "Heartsong".

results.title: Drama Qc : la spirale toxique de TikTok
results.original_title: Drama Qc : la spirale toxique de TikTok
results.overview: The documentary explores the dark, volatile underbelly of Quebec’s TikTok creator ecosystem, where online feuds and personal drama transform into high-viewership reality spectacles—and spill over into real-life harassment.

results.title: Spring
results.overview: A young couple's peaceful getaway to a remote hilltop bungalow takes a terrifying turn as mysterious events unfold. As hidden secrets emerge, their seemingly perfect life is threatened by fear and suspense.

results.title: The Horrors of Respawning
results.overview: Mark invites eight people to the island for a series of challenges, risking their lives to prove a missing member of the SMP has respawned. Meanwhile, JJ's facade begins to slip as the other members reveal secrets that were previously unknown.

results.title: The Jillon
results.overview: From the mind of Harry Hill, starring Richard Ayoade, Richard Syms and Flip Webster comes a gloriously absurd dark comedy about an 86-year-old woman whose desperate wish to become a mother is granted, with consequences nobody could have imagined.

results.title: Silay
results.overview: A wistful college girl, grows an insatiable longing for another girl who seems to follow her everywhere she goes. But whenever she tries to close the distance between them, chance seems to always pull them apart.

results.title: Payong
results.overview: When a girl’s heirloom umbrella mistakenly gets taken by the student next door, she finds herself caught in a chaotic chase to retrieve the one thing she cannot afford to lose.

results.title: Eres especial
results.overview: A man discovers that being "special" isn't always a gift...

results.title: What We Call Home
results.overview: On the outskirts of paradise, a family grows up in a self-governed houseless community on the island of Oʻahu. As the looming threat of government removal draws closer, memories of the community’s past intertwine with an uncertain future. A long-time village resident, a boy on the precipice of adolescence, his carefree younger sister, and their father, the leader of the village, each come to understand what home means in their own way.

results.title: Tutuvi
results.overview: A glimpse into the life, work, community, and collaborations of Japanese-Korean artist and designer Colleen Kimura.

results.title: Unpainted Ghost
results.overview: A Ghost tries to steal a paint.

results.title: Stained
results.overview: An art therapist and nanny are unexpectedly brought together one night by their wealthy client, forcing three generations of women to confront the stains of their past. As long-held tensions resurface and emotional wounds are reopened, they begin to question whether every stain can truly be washed away.

results.title: The Man and the Tree
results.overview: The mango tree in Milton "Papa" Kāne"s backyard has been rooted to his family since the day he was born, his piko planted lovingly beneath it. Now facing a terminal illness, and city enforcement demanding the tree"s removal — more costs his family can"t carry — Papa takes matters into his own hands. Before anyone else can decide the tree"s fate, he gives it, and himself, a send-off no one saw coming.

results.title: Profs
results.overview: A retiring professor battles his ego, confronts his career, and engages with a rebellious former student – soon to be his successor.

results.title: Dealers of Hate
results.overview: Across Central Europe, reports are mounting of Ukrainian refugees — the vast majority women and children — facing harassment and attacks. What’s really behind the headlines about Ukrainians, who were welcomed with open arms in 2022, now facing hatred and hostility? And what role do local politicians play in fueling the violence?  The Kyiv Independent’s new documentary investigates anti-Ukrainian aggression in Germany, the Czech Republic and Poland, the countries that have taken in the largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees since Feb. 24, 2022. Journalist Danylo Mokryk and his team uncover the stories of Ukrainian women who have faced harassment and analyze tens of thousands of posts on X, revealing how hate speech on social media and in political rhetoric escalates into real-world violence.
